scope: Electron-Ion Collider (EIC) facility context and the ePIC experiment, from public documents only. Facility material (beam species, polarization, collision configurations, interaction region) and experiment material (ePIC detector subsystems, early-running proposals, software and data-format entry points) are kept in separate modules with separate scopes. The profile provides sourced design values (EIC facility design targets and requirements, ePIC construction parameters), each quoted from a cited claim, and a configuration checker for measurement- and theory-specs. It runs no ePIC software and ships no performance numbers, datasets or calibration constants.
exclusions: Other EIC detector concepts and proposals (a second-IR detector, earlier proposals) unless a module names them with a source

ePIC internal documents, unpublished performance numbers, calibration constants, production campaigns, analysis cuts and generated samples: project configuration or a local profile, never this profile
Any specific ePIC software release or data-format version not named in the evidence ledger; no executable support is claimed
Measured EIC beam or detector performance: every beam number here is a design target and every detector number a design value unless its claim says otherwise
Datasets: no EIC data exist to record; HERA or other collider practice is never presented as EIC or ePIC practice
maintainer: hchouTW (public-document profile; not endorsed by the EIC project, BNL, Jefferson Lab or the ePIC Collaboration)

capabilities.name: facility-and-detector-context
capabilities.scope: Text modules for EIC facility context and the ePIC detector concept, every factual bullet tied to a ledger claim; guidance, not executable checks and not detector performance

capabilities.name: evidence-ledger
capabilities.scope: Structural validity of the eic ledger (ids, levels, dates, claim-to-source strength, index sync, module citations); not the truth of any claim

capabilities.name: routing-scenarios
capabilities.scope: Generic-DIS, EIC-facility, ePIC-detector, ambiguous-detector, unrelated-experiment, EIC beam-configuration, EIC crossing-angle, EIC theory-settings, ePIC tracking, PID, calorimetry, far-forward, readout, early-running, pi/K-separation and EIC spec-check requests resolve to the expected decision and resource files through contracts/project.py and index.md; static, no model call

capabilities.name: sourced-design-values
capabilities.scope: Every number in the facility and detector modules is quoted from a cited numeric claim with a scope.number_kind (requirement, design-target, design-value, proposal), derived values are recomputed from the stated command, no number stands near a performance word, and numeric claims carry atlas blocks that the hep-detector atlas returns for a project bound to experiment:eic; structural checks, not the truth of any value

capabilities.name: eic-conventions-check
capabilities.scope: scripts/check_eic_conventions.py checks the EIC-specific parts of a measurement-spec or theory-spec (configuration, frames, ion normalization, polarization and azimuth conventions, crossing-angle treatment, beam values sourced from numeric claims, projection labels, facility/experiment scope); nine rule codes and info hints; it does not judge the physics

capabilities.name: software-execution
capabilities.scope: No ePIC software (eic-shell, EICrecon, the epic geometry, EDM4eic) is installed, built or run by this plugin; the software module documents entry points only, with no release pinned
